Overview

Sparks is a city in NV with a population of 108,000. Reno’s sister city with the Nugget Casino, the Sparks Marina, and a growing logistics sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 252 sunny days a year.
